description: More lists from the ad account and its organization (read-only): invoices, transactions, lead forms, a lead count, mobile apps, event details, interaction zones, offer disclaimers, phone numbers (masked), sponsored content, organizations, organization pixels, media stats, catalog products. Pick one with `what`. Contact details are masked.

id.description: Needed for media_stats (media id) and catalog_products (catalog id)

limit.description: Most rows to return. Lower it for a shorter answer; the answer says if more exist.

what.description: Which list: invoices (invoices (billing history)); transactions (payments and charges); lead_forms (lead generation forms); mobile_apps (the organization's mobile apps); event_details (event details (for event ads)); interaction_zones (interaction zones); offer_disclaimers (offer disclaimers); phone_numbers (phone numbers (for click-to-call ads), masked); organizations (the organizations this login belongs to); organization_pixels (pixels across the whole organization); media_stats (performance of one media file (pass id)); catalog_products (products in a catalog (pass the catalog id))

name: snap_account_details
